notes: The four original scenes are preserved verbatim, in chronological order. Target 90–180 seconds; measured audio and media QA are authoritative.

scenes.text: The forest blazed before thunder reached the valley. Ember ran through falling ash, searching for anyone left behind. The paths were empty, yet a strange blue light flickered behind the trees.
scenes.direction: Tracking shot of Ember running through smoke, ducking a collapsing branch.

scenes.text: Moss? Can anyone hear me? The river is behind us, and the fire is moving faster than the wind!
scenes.direction: Ember calls through smoke and springs around flames.

scenes.text: Ember leapt over a burning root and stumbled upon a blue feather. It shone without burning and seemed to pulse like a heartbeat.
scenes.direction: Fox lands, steadies himself, notices the luminous feather.

scenes.text: The sky was clear when the flames began. I know what I saw. But why is this blue feather still glowing? I cannot leave it here.
scenes.direction: Ember reaches toward the feather, then freezes in doubt.

scenes.text: The feather floated upward, defying the wind. Its light cast a tiny moving star across Ember's scarf.
scenes.direction: Close-up of feather drifting and light reflecting off character fur.

scenes.text: Do not touch it, little fox. Things that survive a fire sometimes carry a warning. Step away, slowly.
scenes.direction: Moss appears from smoke, taking grounded steps and raising a foreleg.

scenes.text: Moss! The bridge is gone. Do you know where the others went? I never heard an alarm.
scenes.direction: Ember turns sharply, ears and eyes shifting between Moss and the fire.

scenes.text: The village went north. You are the last I could find. Stay beside me; the earth is burning underneath us.
scenes.direction: Moss tests the soil with a heavy foot and gestures to a safe ledge.

scenes.text: The earth cracked beneath Ember. He slid toward a hole and caught a root just before the ground fell away.
scenes.direction: Forest floor crumbles; fox jumps and grips a root; sparks rise.

scenes.text: Moss! It is breaking! I cannot climb alone!
scenes.direction: Ember struggles, gripping the root with both front paws.

scenes.text: Look at me. Put your foot on that stone. Now reach. Good, little fox. You have got this.
scenes.direction: Moss braces and reaches toward the fox without slipping.

scenes.text: Then the feather lit a path through the smoke. Someone had been here before the storm. It slipped between the black trees like an invitation nobody had asked for.
scenes.direction: Blue feather illuminates a narrow smoke corridor; moving camera follows.

scenes.text: Who left it? Why would someone help us before the fire was even here?
scenes.direction: Ember glances back once, then cautiously follows the feather.

scenes.text: Behind them thunder finally rolled. Ahead, a distant bell answered, and another shape moved in the light. Ember froze.
scenes.direction: Camera widens to unseen shape beyond smoke, cliffhanger; no fire origin reveal.
